_comment: Authoritative source for ALVSolutions' portfolio/demo builds. Project facts are pulled from the existing work.html copy and screenshots — no new claims invented. The homepage reads `chapters` (its four-part work story, in reading order) and resolves each chapter's project from `projects`. work.html still carries its own markup until /work/ is migrated. `reelKey` names the screen objects the held reel animates (hacD, hacP, lucD, lucP).
disclosure: Fictional concept website created by ALVSolutions for portfolio demonstration.

chapters.body: A full restaurant site: menu with photography, hours, location and a reservation form.

chapters.heading: Readable at the table.
chapters.body: The menu is tabbed rather than a printed PDF, so it stays readable on a phone at the table.

chapters.heading: A restaurant and a detailer don't win customers the same way.
chapters.body: So their websites aren't built the same way. Yours starts from how your business works.

link.label: How a site is put together

projects.name: Hacienda Grill
projects.description: A full restaurant site: menu with photography, hours, location and a reservation form. The menu is tabbed rather than a printed PDF, so it stays readable on a phone at the table.

projects.name: Lucid Detailing
projects.description: A mobile detailing site built around booking. Services and pricing are laid out plainly, a gallery carries the before and after work, and the booking call to action follows you down the page.

reelCrop.note: Stops above the demo's fictional statistics bar. Values carried from the locked exploration's Screen Light room (.dev--luc / .dev--phone.dev--luc in phase2-screen-light.css) for whenever a homepage reel needs this crop again.
